what.text: This page follows refugees from Eritrea living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 15456 Eritrean refugees in France, 2.8% of all refugees from Eritrea.
Ethiopia and Sudan host the most Eritrean refugees, followed by Germany and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Eritrea and Ethiopia from 1998 to 2000, reaching war level, and again in 2016.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Eritrea in 1997, 1999 and 2003, with EIJM - AS as the opposition group in 1999 and 2003.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1998 at 5 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
